items.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.summary: MiniMax's new flagship-tier model (Oct 19) claims a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding and cybersecurity with ~3x faster inference and 70% lower cost than its predecessor, plus a 1M-token context window at budget pricing.

items.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek's Oct 17 Pareto update to V4.1 Flash ships open weights under the MIT license on Hugging Face, continuing the Chinese lab's pace of cheap, permissively-licensed frontier-class updates.

items.name: Reflection Beam 1.0
items.summary: Reflection AI's first open-weight model (Oct 16): a 501B-total / 23B-active sparse MoE under Apache 2.0 with 1M context, reporting 81.6% on SWE-bench Verified and ~3x fewer inference reasoning tokens than rivals.

items.name: Meta Muse Wonder / Wonder Full
items.summary: Meta's new Muse-series frontier models (Oct 13) target state-of-the-art personal and professional agentic tasks as Meta pushes deeper into the frontier race against OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.name: Google Gemini 4 Argon (GA)
items.summary: Google's frontier model went globally available Oct 13 with aggressive $2/$10 per-M token introductory pricing (doubling Nov 30), plus misuse/jailbreak defenses, agent alignment and prompt-injection resistance for its security story.
